name: Dockerfile (Java)
description: A multi-stage Dockerfile: build a Maven project, run its jar on a JRE as a non-root user
body: # Build stage: resolve dependencies first (cached while pom.xml is unchanged), then package.
# Runtime stage: only the JRE and the application jar, run as an unprivileged user.
# The jar Maven builds: set <finalName>${jarName:app}</finalName> in pom.xml, or change the name here.
